preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of the string n for each test case must be between 2 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abc' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must only contain characters 'a', 'b', and 'c'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(length) if length != -1 else stdout == '-1'
postconditions.description: The output must be the length of the smallest valid substring or -1 if no such substring exists.
The length of the valid substring must be at least 2.
The count of 'a' in the substring must be strictly greater than the counts of 'b' and 'c'.
